findings.body:
**Preserve the receipt-recovery instruction on replay.**

At `src/policy/crq/reviewAdmission.ts:356`, an unavailable receipt adds `next_action: "resubmit"` only to this response. The returned queue does not retain that condition. If the client retries the same request, `retryRequest` calls `reviewStatus` and returns `completed` without the recovery instruction.

Persist the receipt-unavailable condition, or apply the same receipt check when projecting subsequent status responses.
findings.title: Preserve the receipt-recovery instruction on replay.

findings.body:
**Preserve commit distance when tree evidence is missing.**

With complete history A→B and `headTree=null`, ancestry establishes `commitsAhead=1`, but `headline.delta` is null. This condition selects the fallback, which sets `delta.commits_ahead=null` at Line 565. The cue then incorrectly reports shallow or missing history.

Construct the fallback tree delta first. Then attach the known commit distance independently of tree availability.
findings.title: Preserve commit distance when tree evidence is missing.
Keep every request binding for a reused item.
